https://biz.chosun.com/en/en-finance/202.next: Data-center supply chain mein aur bare deals expected hain.
https://biz.chosun.com/en/en-finance/202.take: AI ko thanda rakhne wale bhi crorepati ban rahe hain 😭. Lesson: gold rush mein belche bechne wala jeetta hai.
https://biz.chosun.com/en/en-finance/202.what: LG Electronics ne North America mein AI data centers ke liye 5 gigawatt cooling equipment ka long-term deal sign kiya — khabar par shares 6% uchle.

https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/interna.next: Deal finalize hui to OpenAI duniya ki sab se valuable private tech company ban jayegi.
https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/interna.take: Bhai $1.4 TRILLION — itne mein poora Pakistan 3 baar khareed lo 😭. Lekin seriously: jab UAE paisa laga raha hai, samjho AI ab oil jaisa asset hai.
https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/interna.what: OpenAI UAE ke MGX fund aur BlackRock se $30 billion raise karne ki baat kar raha hai — $1.4 trillion valuation par. IPO 2027 tak postpone, company ka kehna hai focus AI safety par hai.
https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/interna.why: Ye AI race ka scale dikhata hai: ab sirf models nahi, paisa bhi weapon hai. Gulf ka paisa AI mein lag raha hai — Pakistani devs ke liye signal hai ke AI infra jobs aur funding dono barh rahe hain.

https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business.next: Weights release ke baad independent benchmarks batayenge ke claim kitna sach tha.
https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business.take: GLM-5.2 ko takkar, aur wo bhi quarter compute par? Agar ye sach nikla to indie hackers ki Eid ho jayegi 👀. Waitlist par lag jao.
https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business.what: Nvidia-backed startup Reflection AI ne Beam launch kiya — open-weight model: 501B total params lekin sirf 23B active per task. Claim hai China ke GLM-5.2 jaisi reasoning 3–4x kam compute par. Weights is mahine Apache 2.0 license par ayenge.
https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business.why: Open models ka matlab: tum ise apne server par free chala sakte ho. Pakistani devs ke liye yehi rasta hai — mehngi API bills ke baghair AI products banana.

https://www.urdupoint.com/en/pakistan/pa.take: 2026 mein bhi 4 ghante bijli ghaib… aur hum AI superintelligence ki baatein kar rahe hain 💀. Pehle bijli, phir future.

https://www.reuters.com/world/china/mist.take: Har CEO kehta hai 'hum sab se behtar hain' 😂 — benchmark ayen to baat karein. Lekin Europe ka AI mein wapas ana waqai interesting hai.
